title: Oven Roasted Ukrainian Chicken Wrap
description: A sweet and crumbly Ukrainian dish featuring chicken drumsticks, bhuna, and corn husk wraps, perfect for a low-calorie hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the bhuna spice mix, olive oil, honey, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Wrap each chicken drumstick in a corn husk, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Place the wrapped chicken drumsticks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Flip the chicken drumsticks over and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken drumsticks in their corn husk wraps, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
